summary: Defines enhancements to OSPF to support Opaque LSAs, a new class of link-state advertisement that carries application-specific information through the network. It was replaced by RFC 5250.

eli5.summary: A way for routers to pass along extra notes inside their map-sharing messages, even if they do not understand them.

questions: what is an ospf opaque lsa
how to extend ospf with new information
